reviews.text:
I had a very good experience with Dr. Vautier; his method of gentle medicine and homeopathy is incredible.

I've never seen my cat so calm since I started taking her to this vet.
He is a very kind and gentle person with animals and also very responsive on the phone.

My dog ​​has been a patient for several years.

She's always very happy to go.

Dr. Vautier is amazing! Thank you again for practicing for our animals... Veterinary medicine, osteopathy, energy work, and herbal medicine are all available!

Finally, a veterinarian who truly considers animals as a whole! Dr. Vautier takes the necessary time, listens attentively, and is very receptive; his honesty and effectiveness are astounding. I highly recommend him to anyone seeking a more natural approach to medicine that genuinely considers each animal's unique needs. Each visit is like a truly authentic interlude, a welcome respite from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Thank you again.
I took my two cats there for an energy healing session. The vet was lovely, very gentle and respectful of both animals and humans. The session was gentle and calming.
A very warm welcome. Our dog, who is usually very wary, felt right at home. Treats included ☺️
A kind and competent veterinarian. I've been taking my cats there for a very long time. I highly recommend him.

What can I say? Words can't express it. I brought my 11-year-old cat to Dr. Vautier in early November 2023, completely desperate. He's had epilepsy for many years, but the seizures had disappeared for a few years, thanks in part to herbal treatment. For the past year, the seizures had been recurring regularly (about one every 10 days). I couldn't find a solution anymore. My cat then went to Dr. Vautier... and since then, nothing. I can't believe it. My little darling is even much calmer now. A huge thank you to him for his gentleness, kindness, attentiveness, expertise, and especially his magic hands. He truly connects with our companions.

I accompanied a friend to her cat's appointment for a blood test.

The reception was excellent, and the staff were very kind and arrived on time. They gave me lots of advice on feeding and portion sizes for my 4.5kg Norwegian Forest Cat.

I highly recommend them! 👍
Excellent vet! Thank you for taking care of our 18-year-old cat 😇 …
Always attentive, available, and responsive to our needs. I am delighted to be cared for by Dr. Vautier, in whom I have complete confidence. 👍🙏😊 …
